SELECT merged.bizType, merged.bizId, merged.questionId, merged.title, merged.answerCount, merged.likeCount, merged.favoriteCount, merged.favoriteAt FROM ( SELECT 1 AS bizType, f.question_id AS bizId, f.question_id AS questionId, q.title AS title, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, f.created_at AS favoriteAt FROM qa_favorite f JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = f.question_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status IN (1, 5)
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS bizType, v.biz_id AS bizId, NULL AS questionId, kb.title AS title, 0 AS answerCount, kb.like_count AS likeCount, kb.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, v.created_at AS favoriteAt FROM qa_vote v JOIN kb_entry kb ON kb.id = v.biz_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.biz_type = 6 AND v.vote_type = 1 AND kb.status = 1 ) merged ORDER BY merged.favoriteAt DESC, merged.bizId DESC
